import sys,json,subprocess,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
import checker, gen
rng=random.Random(777)
reqs=[]
for _ in range(600):
    r=gen.gen_request(rng)
    for e in r["edges"]: e["capacity"]=1024
    r["budget"]=98304
    # lower demands to keep feasible
    for c in r["commodities"]: c["demand"]=rng.randint(0,20)
    reqs.append(r)
data=b"".join((json.dumps(r)+"\n").encode() for r in reqs)
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
outs=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.splitlines()]
from collections import Counter
cnt=Counter(o.get("status") for o in outs)
nf=0
for req,o in zip(reqs,outs):
    e,_=checker.check(req,o)
    if e:
        nf+=1
        if nf<=5: print("FAIL",e,json.dumps(req)[:300],json.dumps(o)[:300])
print("stats",cnt,"fails",nf,"nouts",len(outs))
PY
python feas_many.py
